segment_contamination_dimensions: Portable and relocatable toilet buyers (event hire, temporary site use, mobile deployment) — siblings Portable Toilets, FRP Portable Toilet, MS Portable Toilets, Sintex Portable Toilets, Mobile Toilets, Mobile Toilet Van, Bunk House Portable Toilets attract buyers seeking lightweight, relocatable units; RCC Toilet buyers seek permanent or semi-permanent fixed-installation structures for rural/public sanitation — names implying portability, mobility, or temporary use are blocked

Modular partition and cubicle buyers (interior fit-out, washroom partition systems) — siblings Toilet Cubicles and Toilet Partitions attract buyers sourcing internal partition hardware for existing buildings; RCC Toilet buyers are procuring complete standalone structural units — names implying partition panels or interior cubicle fit-out are blocked

Specialised treatment-technology toilet buyers — sibling Bio Toilet and Chemical Toilets attract buyers specifically seeking biological or chemical waste-treatment systems as the primary differentiator; while RCC toilets may connect to bio-digesters, the RCC material and precast structure are the defining buyer criteria — names foregrounding bio or chemical treatment as the primary product identity are blocked

FRP/fibre modular toilet buyers — siblings FRP Modular Toilet and FRP Portable Toilet attract buyers seeking fibre-reinforced plastic units (lighter, corrosion-resistant, relocatable); RCC Toilet buyers are explicitly choosing concrete/cement construction for permanence and structural strength — names using FRP, fibre, or GRP as the primary material descriptor are blocked
PVC and plastic toilet buyers — sibling PVC Toilet attracts buyers seeking plastic-bodied units; any name implying plastic or PVC construction is blocked
